fields.description: Issue includes an editorial criticizing authorities for not charging Fred Osius after a causeway crash in which Mrs. Bain Miller and her young son were killed, questioning enforcement of traffic and liquor laws. Other pieces discuss Miami and Miami Beach civic matters including police personnel decisions, city manager resignation, Fourth of July commentary, harbor/wharfage charges, and calls for an airport and aviation development. Columns and local notes cover bootlegging-related anecdotes, community gossip, and sports promotions including boxing matches and baseball commentary.
